svg.title: Four green gauges and a model that has quietly failed
svg.desc: Four ticked golden-signal gauges - p99 61 milliseconds, 97 requests per second, zero errors, 41 percent CPU - feeding a large word GREEN, separated by a thick red line labelled nothing connects these from a model box reading accuracy 93.8 percent falling to 89.6; below, a fifth larger amber distribution gauge holds two overlaid histograms at PSI 0.31, two clock faces compare 41 minutes of drift detection against 3.1 days for labels, and a burn-rate fuel bar carries four alert arrows of different thickness from 14.4x paging down to 1x ticketing, beside a struck-out static latency alert.
svg.text: Four green gauges and a model that has quietly failed
